## After merge

---

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat:`, `fix:`, `feat!:` for breaking changes)
- [ ] Every command under Commands in `AGENTS.md` passes; changed snapshots reviewed
- [ ] `GLOSSARY.md`, ADRs and docs updated if behaviour or terms changed
- [ ] No API tokens, `.env` files or local agent files are included
